dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus visible in frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and devoid of asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with subtle blue-toned shadows along the lateral slopes.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast linear scratches or rake marks are visible across the dorsal surface, particularly on the left and right lateral planes.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, raised longitudinal dorsal ridge creates a linear shadow-cast along the central axis; no traumatic indentations detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring consistent with rake marks distributed across the dorsal and lateral skin surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced and well-defined central dorsal ridge extending the length of the visible posterior half.
